records.title: Scope and deadline of China's export-control suspension

finding.text: China's 7 November 2025 announcement 70 suspends named October instruments 55–58 and 61–62 through 10 November 2026. It does not list April announcement 18, which established licensing for specified rare-earth items.

relationToCreator.text: The creator's geopolitical-leverage theme is an interpretation. Suspending the named October instruments does not demonstrate that every rare-earth restriction was suspended. These legal records do not validate every statement in the unverified repost.

records.title: Expired US authorizations for particular Iranian-oil transactions

finding.text: OFAC General License U authorized specified Iranian-oil transactions for cargo loaded by 12:01 a.m. EDT on 20 March 2026, until 12:01 a.m. EDT on 19 April. General License X1 later authorized limited wind-down transactions through 12:01 a.m. EDT on 17 July 2026. Both periods had ended by this review.

relationToCreator.text: License U was in force when the March 31 video appeared, so its title cannot establish a universal prohibition. This comparison addresses the title and reviewed description, not an unread transcript. Expired licenses provide historical context rather than current permission.

records.title: Q2 productivity measures and the limits of an AI explanation

finding.text: BLS reported Q2 2026 nonfarm-business productivity growth of 1.4% at a seasonally adjusted quarterly annualized rate and 2.2% from Q2 2025. These compare different periods. The revised release was published on 3 September 2026.

relationToCreator.text: This later release is context rather than evidence available at the May 29 publication. Aggregate output per hour does not identify an AI contribution or establish a general household prosperity forecast.

sources.title: Productivity and Costs, Second Quarter 2026, Revised

limitations: Quarterly annualization is not the four-quarter comparison. The statistics do not identify an AI cause or validate the creator's proprietary freight indicators.
